title: Olbers' Paradox: Why Is the Night Sky Dark?
question: If the universe is infinite, eternal, and full of stars, why isn't every point in the night sky as bright as the sun?
summary: A simple observation — the sky goes dark at night — turns out to be one of the most powerful clues in the history of cosmology, ruling out an infinite, static, eternal universe long before anyone had proof the universe was expanding.
